name: Anowon
description: A vampire archaeomancer once enthralled to the Eldrazi, freed when the brood are killed; accompanies Sorin.

description_citations.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
description_citations.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace rips the Eye of Ugin's location from Anowon's mind.
timeline.quote: Jace ripped the information he sought from the vampire's mind

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa, Sorin and Anowon cross Makindi, endure the Roil, meet the kor prophet Smara and battle hazards.
timeline.quote: met the kor prophet Smara

citation.text: "Makindi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bloodchief Tenihas is murdered in his bedroom; the only witness swears Anowon did it and vanished.
timeline.quote: The only surviving witness swore that Anowon had killed his bloodchief in a fit of rage and then vanished.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anowon acquires the Dragon's Fire scroll on an expedition, then renounces Bala Ged Expeditionary House and disappears.
timeline.quote: Anowon acquired a powerful scroll now known as the Dragon's Fire.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Bala Ged Expeditionary House". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Posing as Kejahar, Anowon infiltrates the scholars of the Lighthouse in Sea Gate and links the Eye of Ugin to the secret past of vampires.
timeline.quote: Anowon made a connection between the Eye of Ugin and the secret past of the vampires that Tenihas had so carefully protected.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "The Infiltration of Sea Gate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A kor woman who knew Anowon is found dead, and the militia uncover his vampire nature.
timeline.quote: they uncovered his hidden nature as a vampire.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "The Infiltration of Sea Gate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The enraged townspeople beat Anowon nearly to death and cast him into the Halimar, but he survives.
timeline.quote: They then cast his broken body over the seawall and into the waters of the Halimar far below.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "The Infiltration of Sea Gate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Sea Gate, Anowon steals and kills indiscriminately in his hunt for the Eye of Ugin from his Akoum camp.
timeline.quote: From then on, he stole and killed indiscriminately to accomplish his goals.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "League of Anowon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar appears in Anowon's camp asking for guidance, and he agrees once he learns she also seeks the Eye.
timeline.quote: One day, the young planeswalker Chandra Nalaar appeared in his camp, asking for Anowon's guidance.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anowon discovers Chandra has a physical map and tries to kill her; Sarkhan Vol knocks him out.
timeline.quote: He soon discovered that Nalaar actually possessed a physical map and so tried to kill her.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace Beleren finds Anowon feeding off his guide, disables him, reads his mind, and persuades him to lead him to the Eye.
timeline.quote: Anowon attacked Jace, but the mind mage disabled him and read his mind

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The released Brood Lineage find Anowon near the Eye and enslave him for three months.
timeline.quote: they found Anowon near the Eye and enslaved him like all other vampires they encounter.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Enslavement and Return to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov and Nissa Revane free Anowon, who accompanies them to the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: until he was freed by Sorin Markov and Nissa Revane on the outskirts of Turntimber forest.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Enslavement and Return to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa's actions release the Eldrazi Titans and Anowon flees with the planeswalkers to Affa, where they part ways.
timeline.quote: they fled together to Affa where they parted ways.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Enslavement and Return to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anowon betrays Chandra and tries to kill her in her sleep; Sarkhan knocks him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Luckily for Chandra, Sarkhan Vol ambushed Anowon, rendering him unconscious with a swift strike to the head.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Sarkhan to guard the Eye; Chandra and Jace, guided by Anowon, confront him there, and Chandra's invisible flame spell loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
timeline.quote: thus unknowingly loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Second breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns, frees Anowon and goes with Nissa to the Eye, where Nissa shatters the main hedron, releasing the Eldrazi; Sorin leaves the plane.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov arrives in time to save Nissa from the brood.
timeline.quote: Nissa would have fallen to the brood herself if not for the timely arrival of Sorin Markov

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan wanders the Eye of Ugin on Bolas's orders and saves Chandra from Anowon.
timeline.quote: he became lucid in time to save Chandra Nalaar from an attack by the vampire ruin sage named Anowon

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa destroys the keylock hedron, completing the Release of the Eldrazi despite Sorin's intent to reseal the prison.
timeline.quote: Nissa instead acted by destroying the keylock hedron, and the Release of the Eldrazi was a fact.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa meets Sorin and Anowon, who is freed when the brood are killed; Sorin recruits Nissa to guide him to Akoum.
timeline.quote: He recruits Nissa to help him reach Akoum , where the Eye of Ugin lies.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group visits Khalled in Graypelt for supplies and a piece of Tal Terig.
timeline.quote: Khalled offers what help he can, including a piece of the puzzle tower Tal Terig

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They meet Smara and her goblin companions and agree to journey together to the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: and Sorin suggests they journey together.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A vampiric death in Zulaport blamed on the group forces them to flee; Nissa steals a boat and summons a beast to pull it.
timeline.quote: Nissa steals a boat and summons a massive beast to swim the ocean and pull the boat.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anowon kills a scout who saved them, with Sorin's permission, shocking Nissa.
timeline.quote: only for Anowon to kill the man with Sorin’s permission, shocking Nissa.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa pushes Sorin to admit he is a vampire and the cause of the vanishings.
timeline.quote: he admits to being a vampire and the real reason so many around them have vanished during the trip.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A vampire consoles Nissa, reveals he knows her name and her spark, and tells her the world is ending.
timeline.quote: "That is fair considering your history with vampires, Nissa."

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: The vampire offers four seeds from Anowon, including the last bloodbriar of Bala Ged, asking Nissa to take them to another plane.
timeline.quote: "Kolya, red mangrove, jaddi, bloodbriar."

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: After Ulamog destroys Bala Ged, an unnamed Malakir vampire gives Nissa seeds of Zendikar's plants on Anowon's behalf.
timeline.quote: The vampire beseeched her to take the seeds and plant them on another plane.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Gift to Nissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns to Zendikar, allying with Nissa and freeing Anowon to reach the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: he liberated the vampiric slave Anowon and demanded that the two take him to the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Return to Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anowon joins three adventurers to research the Ondu Skyclave and eliminate the Hydra Grakmaw.
timeline.quote: He found a new home with three adventurers whom he had joined to research the Ondu Skyclave and to eliminate the Hydra Grakmaw .

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Decline in reputation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An emissary seeks out Tarsa in Nimana's market, while the vampire Anowon secretly follows.
timeline.quote: Neither had noticed the vampire behind them

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Eret seizes Anowon as a spy, and Anowon asks to join the party for a fraction of the earnings in exchange for knowledge.
timeline.quote: I offer to serve your party for a fraction of your earnings.

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The party sails to Jwar Isle, tormented by suspicions of Anowon, and hears the faduun.
timeline.quote: Behind him, he could hear a dark, gravelly voice grumble in a tongue unknown to him.

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Anowon scouts ahead and climbs the cliffs, then reaches the Skyclave and studies the walls, finding they are also a map.
timeline.quote: It's also a map.

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Grakmaw attacks, but Anowon's idea of becoming cold lets the party hide beneath snow from its heat sense.
timeline.quote: You all need to become colder!

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Anowon drinks vials of blood to heal, and Tarsa asks why he really travels with them.
timeline.quote: What is so important about this to you?

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Anowon studies the Skyclave and learns the walls describe a weapons facility that rebelled against the kor capital at Makindi.
timeline.quote: This was the Skyclave that rebelled against the ancient kor capital at Makindi.

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the proving room where Nadino finds remains of Orien's scarf.
timeline.quote: That damned . . . thing . . . dragged him here . . . tore him up . . .

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Tarsa objects to Anowon taking kor poisons, and Grakmaw attacks the proving room.
timeline.quote: Any hands that know how to twist Zendikar are the wrong hands.

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Anowon throws a kor potion, shattered by Nadino's blade, that turns Grakmaw's heads to stone and kills it.
timeline.quote: In a matter of seconds, all the beast's heads were sharp, spiked stone

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Tarsa thanks Anowon and invites him to be their fourth hook; Anowon realizes he longs for belonging.
timeline.quote: You're free to be our fourth hook whenever you wish.

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Anowon joins Tarsa, Nadino and Eret on an expedition to the Skyclave.
timeline.quote: the vampire scholar Anowon join a reluctant band of adventurers

citation.text: "Ondu Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grakmaw attacks the party in the ruins and proves nearly impossible to kill.
timeline.quote: its regenerative heads made it nearly impossible to kill

citation.text: "Ondu Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anowon and Nadino use a petrification potion to turn Grakmaw to stone; Tarsa offers Anowon a place among them.
timeline.quote: used it to turn Grakmaw to stone mid-battle, ending the threat

citation.text: "Ondu Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Delivers the seeds as gifts from Anowon.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

relations.note: Tenihas took him in and taught him histories.
relations.quote: Tenihas of House Ghet took him in and taught him to value the histories

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

relations.note: Anowon was under his tutelage and viewed him as a father figure.
relations.quote: Anowon viewed Tenihas as a father figure

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Freed him from the Eldrazi and travelled with him.
relations.quote: He then accompanied the two planeswalkers to the Eye of Ugin

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Enslavement and Return to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Offered him a place among them.
relations.quote: Tarsa, moved by the vampire's integrity, offered him a place among them going forward.

citation.text: "Ondu Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An old vampire who spoke of Nissa's spark and whose gifts of seeds the vampire envoy brings.

citation.text: "For Zendikar" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2015.

pages_say.description: A vampire sage who swore the Eldrazi would leave Zendikar if freed and who guided Jace to the Eye.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

pages_say.description: A disgraced Malakir vampire sage of House Ghet who joins Tarsa's party to study the Ondu Skyclave, hoping for knowledge and redemption.

citation.text: "Hunger" by Brandon O'Brien. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2020.

pages_say.description: The founder of the League of Anowon training camp in the Teeth.

citation.text: "Akoum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An archaeomancer and scion of a powerful vampire family from Malakir on Zendikar, who searches relentlessly for the Eye of Ugin.

citation.text: "Anowon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A ruin sage on Zendikar and leader of the League of Anowon who betrays Chandra.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A vampire who guides Jace and Chandra, and is later liberated by Sorin.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A vampire ruin-sage of Zendikar who guides Jace to the Eye of Ugin.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Traveler who crossed Makindi with Nissa and Sorin.

citation.text: "Makindi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A vampiric Ruin Sage freed by Sorin who travelled with Nissa.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Vampire scholar who joins an expedition and petrifies Grakmaw.

citation.text: "Ondu Skyclave". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Zendikar sage with expertise in ruins, runes and ancient languages.

citation.text: "Sage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A vampire ruin sage who attacked Chandra in the Eye of Ugin.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A vampire ruin sage freed from slavery by Sorin.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A vampire scholar present with Nissa and Sorin at the Eye of Ugin.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
